verdict.rationale: First-party docs make creating a skill minimal: create a folder with a `SKILL.md`, and Claude adds it and lets you invoke it with `/skill-name`. A template SKILL.md is provided, and the official repo documents a two-command install (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then `/plugin install`). A recorded runtime probe completed a real keyless install of one skill in a scratch project, which suggests the path is fast and works. missing for 10: an explicit timed quickstart guide demonstrating under five minutes, hands-on verification of the first-party `/plugin` install path (the probe used third-party `npx skills` tooling), and confirmation that the installed skill then ran successfully.
